references.title: GEO: Generative Engine Optimization

en.why: Defines GEO as optimizing content for generative engines and reports measurable visibility gains from citation-oriented content.

zh.why: 提出 GEO（生成式引擎优化）概念，并证明面向引用的内容调整能提升生成式引擎中的可见度。

references.title: Evaluating Verifiability in Generative Search Engines

en.why: Shows that generative search answers often lack citations and can contradict their own sources — why evidence and citation checks matter.

zh.why: 研究表明生成式搜索的回答经常缺少引用、甚至与自身来源矛盾——这正是必须做证据与引用校验的原因。

references.title: Lost in the Middle: How Language Models Use Long Contexts

en.why: Provides evidence that models use information in the middle of long contexts poorly — supports chunking content and putting key facts early.

zh.why: 证明模型对长上下文中部信息的利用较差——支持「chunk 分块、关键事实前置」的做法。

references.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks

en.why: The foundational RAG paper: retrieval + generation is why machine-readable, retrievable content matters.

zh.why: RAG 的基础论文：检索 + 生成，正是「内容可被检索」决定 AI 能否正确回答的原因。

references.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Large Language Models: A Survey

en.why: Survey of RAG architectures and chunking/retrieval trade-offs — useful for structuring content for retrieval.

zh.why: 系统梳理 RAG 架构与 chunk/检索权衡——对「为检索而组织内容」有直接参考价值。

references.title: WebGPT: Browser-assisted question-answering with human feedback

en.why: Early browser-augmented answering work: models read and cite web pages, which is why page-level readability and citations matter.

zh.why: 早期「浏览器增强问答」研究：模型会读取并引用网页，说明页面可读性与引用为何重要。
